name: Eric Stevens
occupation: Crook County coroner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Eric Stevens is the Crook County coroner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Michael Frolander, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists him as the winner of the coroner race.

sources.name: Crook County official 2026 general election summary
